scope: Fixed-supply laboratory OpenLVDS; receiver screening does not qualify a PHY
legacy_captured_replay: Preserved stress diagnostic; its result is not a new admission gate
dynamic_acceptance: Compliant corrected TX/channel/native RX loopback at required rate; no separate full-rate 100 mV demand at every common mode

release_requires.other_gates: LVDS TX waveform/levels, selected-slew aperture brackets, DLL 336 cases and all 15 stability/recovery/readiness/OTA cases, current OpenPLL contract and six RC certificates
